# CANDIDATE: GAP_FAIL_REJECTION_VOL_RSI

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A gap up that fails to hold VWAP with a volume spike and bearish RSI divergence offers a short‑side mean‑reversion edge. The gap creates an overextended open, the VWAP break signals loss of intraday bullish momentum, the volume spike confirms participation, and the RSI divergence warns of weakening upside, together increasing the probability of a pullback.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** If the open gaps up >0.2% of prior close, within the first 15 minutes price crosses below VWAP, the 5‑min bar's volume >1.5× the average 5‑min volume of the prior 20 bars, and RSI(14) makes a lower high while price makes a higher high (bearish divergence), enter short at the bar's close.  
**Exit:** Chart‑stop at the recent swing high (prior bar high), TP1 at 1R, runner trail 15% off the high‑water mark. Regime filter: only consider when VIX > 18 and time is within the first 30 minutes of trading.
